text:
liam_partnerships: Quick sync request — vendor launch pacing for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi across regions. Need final embargo windows, SI support headcounts, and a fallback capacity plan by Wed EOD. cc @sara_pm @dom_infra

sara_pm: Thanks. Can you clarify vendor deliverables vs SI deliverables? I can pull press calendars once windows are locked.

liam_partnerships: Vendors need: embargo window, SKU tags, firmware freeze date. We need from SI: cert window + 2-week dryrun. Also want a clear SLA matrix (p99 latency targets) tied to launch traffic estimates.

dom_infra: infra note — sustained slots we can commit for launch week: us-west-2: 250 H100-equiv; us-east-1: 180; eu-west-1: 80. If we enable burst pool, add +30% but not guaranteed across tenants. Kernel image must be final by Tue to avoid cold-start regressions.

anika_eng: Runtime compatibility update: MI300 quantized images still show 2 perf regressions on seq > 2048. Patch in next runtime release fixes it but forces firmware freeze move. Options: delay EU launch 1 week or ship with routing mitigations.

alex_supply: Shipping update — H200 racks delayed in APAC, vendor ETA slipped ~+10–12 days. Gaudi inventory is OK. B200 limited but we can reallocate pre-prod units if needed for SI.

maria_pr: For announcements: we need final embargo date + 24-hr press window and a partnerships rep on the presser call. Will draft spokes and likely customer Qs — need them by Tue.

deploy-bot: [CI] preflight check passed for market-assets (build #872). No blocked tests.

sara_pm: Proposal: lock embargo windows per region by Tue COB. If MI300 patch forces fw freeze shift, then shift EU launch by 1 week to keep feature parity across regions.

liam_partnerships: Agreed. Draft capacity matrix (baseline):
```
region, h100_equiv, mi300_nodes, gaudi_nodes
us-west-2, 250, 60, 40
us-east-1, 180, 40, 30
eu-west-1, 80, 20, 10
apac-southeast-1, 60, 10, 8
```
Alex, please update with final ETAs and contingency pools.

anika_eng: Also adding runtime fallback plan: if MI300 regression persists, route high-latency jobs (>2s) to H100 pool and enable reduced-batch mode for quantized paths. Will add smart-routing policy draft to the playbook.

alex_supply: ETAs updated: H200 APAC now +12 days due to vendor microcode rerun. I'll add contingency allocations + priority tagging in slotting doc.

maria_pr: I'll prepare embargo language and a one-pager. Who's the owner for scheduling the SI dryrun?

sara_pm: Owners: @anika_eng owns dryrun technical plan, @liam_partnerships coordinates SI contacts, @alex_supply owns hardware availability and contingency.

liam_partnerships: Action items:
- @anika_eng: dryrun schedule + fallback routing config by Mon 10:00 PT
- @alex_supply: update slot ETAs + contingency pool by Mon EOD
- @sara_pm: lock press calendar & share presser invite by Tue
- @maria_pr: embargo draft + customer Qs by Tue AM
I'll send a calendar invite for a cross-org dryrun on Tue 15:00 PT. Thanks :thumbsup:

sara_pm: acked — I'll reserve the presser room and invite vendor comms.

dom_infra: noted. Will prioritize kernel image bake for Tue morning.

anika_eng: will post the fallback policy draft in the runbook and ping here when done.

alex_supply: I'll update the slotting doc and ping vendors for confirmed ship dates.

maria_pr: prepping the one-pager now, will share a draft link shortly.

liam_partnerships: Great sync — will follow up with invite + consolidated doc by EOD.
